The new column is a derived canonical form beside it, not a replacement for it. IT WRITES TO EXISTING ROWS, WHICH IS WHY THIS IS CLASSIFIED BACKFILL AND NOT EXPAND. READINESS: the command counts links whose typed number IS normalisable by the migration’s own rule but which still carry no canonical form. It must return 0. When the projection began indexing External Intake identity — Customer ID, recipient name, address and phone — every document already written became unable to answer a question about those fields, while remaining entirely valid-looking: its source row was untouched, so no timestamp showed it, and the reindex only ever selected evidence rows with NO document at all (`esd.id IS NULL`).
